contexts.text: I have spoken with... Penn, who said that he has no part (in the nefarious deeds of the Quakers).

A certain person spoke with me from a somewhat high place in front. It was said that it was Penn, from whom Pennsylvania [was named]. He spoke well; and, as he perceived that [the Quakers] are such, he averred that he has not been such, and that it is abominable... LJPost 59.
